readme.summary: Excellent documentation with clear purpose, comprehensive installation options, and good editor integration guides, though configuration section appears truncated and could benefit from more complete examples.

injection_risks.description: The use of env::var() could potentially lead to an injection risk if the environment variable is not properly sanitized.
The use of dirs::data_local_dir(), dirs::data_dir(), and dirs::home_dir() could potentially lead to an injection risk if the directory paths are not properly sanitized.
